description: Income support to landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families; institutional landholders, income-tax payers and some professionals are excluded.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000, directly to the bank account.
documents_required: Aadhaar, land records, bank account details.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or via the Common Service Centre or the local agriculture officer.

description: Cashless hospitalisation insurance for poor and vulnerable families.
eligibility: Families identified from the SECC 2011 database; senior citizens aged 70 and above are also covered.
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals.
documents_required: Aadhaar, ration card or other identity proof.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or at an Ayushman Mitra desk in an empanelled hospital and get the Ayushman card.

description: Assistance to build a pucca house for rural households without adequate housing.
eligibility: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha houses, selected using the Awaas Plus survey list.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly and difficult areas, plus support under MGNREGA for labour.
how_to_apply: Selection is from the Awaas Plus list through the Gram Panchayat; contact the Block Development Office.

description: Deposit-free LPG connections for women from poor households.
eligibility: Adult woman from a poor household with no existing LPG connection in the household.
benefits: Free LPG connection with the first refill and stove support as notified.
documents_required: Aadhaar, ration card, bank account, KYC form.
how_to_apply: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor or online on the PMUY portal.

description: Small savings scheme for the girl child.
eligibility: Account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years of age; maximum two accounts per family in general.
benefits: Minimum deposit Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1.5 lakh per financial year; interest rate is notified quarterly; account matures 21 years after opening.
documents_required: Birth certificate of the girl, parent or guardian ID and address proof.
how_to_apply: Open at any post office or authorised bank branch.

description: Guaranteed pension scheme mainly for unorganised sector workers.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account.
benefits: Fixed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60, depending on contribution.
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank branch or net banking.

eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18 to 50 giving auto-debit consent.
benefits: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh on death for any reason; premium Rs 436 per year.
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank or the jansuraksha portal.

eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18 to 70 giving auto-debit consent.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh on accidental death or full disability and Rs 1 lakh on partial disability; premium Rs 20 per year.
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank or the jansuraksha portal.

description: Guaranteed wage employment for rural households.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per financial year; wages are paid to the bank or post office account.
how_to_apply: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat, then submit a written or oral request for work.

eligibility: Any Indian citizen without a bank account.
benefits: Zero-balance basic savings account, RuPay debit card and accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh with the card.
documents_required: Aadhaar or other officially valid document.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any bank branch or through a Business Correspondent.

description: Centralised online portal to lodge grievances against central and state government departments.
eligibility: Any citizen with a complaint about a government service.
benefits: Complaint gets a registration number and can be tracked online; the department must respond within the prescribed time.
documents_required: Basic identity and contact details, description of the issue, supporting documents.
how_to_apply: Register the grievance at the CPGRAMS portal and track it using the registration number.

description: Law that lets citizens request information from public authorities.
benefits: Application fee of Rs 10 for central public authorities; the authority must generally reply within 30 days.
documents_required: Written application or online application with the fee.
how_to_apply: File online on the RTI Online portal for central ministries or to the Public Information Officer of the department.
